collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen has woven a beautiful new roof for the mud hut. It also leaks.

description_variants.description: An Isolan has woven a beautiful new roof for the mud hut. It also leaks.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (name1) has woven a new roof for the mud hut out of palm fronds, red vine and something shiny (he/she) found on the beach. It is, everyone agrees, the most beautiful roof the camp has ever had. It also leaks. (name1) says the leaks are part of the design. The Heathens' village has a new roof. \(no effect\)
